$comment: Pinned toolchain for factorio-csharp. `factorio-mod bootstrap` verifies these and records the result in build/toolchain.lock.json.

dotnet.note: Any .NET 8 SDK >= 8.0.4xx works; 8.0.426 is the version used for the recorded test run.

cscharplua.note: Upstream master targets an .NET preview SDK. tools/patches/cscharplua-net8.patch retargets only the launcher to net8.0; the compiler itself still targets netstandard2.1. No compiler logic is modified.

lua.note: Factorio uses a modified Lua 5.2. Local tests run under stock Lua 5.2.4 for syntax/semantic checks; this is NOT a substitute for the in-game integration test.

factorio.note: `version` is the default: what `generate` writes when no version is named, and what a mod gets when its mod.json says nothing. `factorioVersions` maps the string a mod writes in mod.json to the API documentation version; each one gets its own api/<version>/ documents and Generated/<version>/ bindings. A mod declaring an older version loads in that version and every newer one, so 2.0 is the default for new mods.
